newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Michelin said to have bought RSS3 in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Michelin said to have bought RSS3 in Singapore.

text.p: Michelin is said to have bought several hundred tonnes of RSS3 rubber while other buyers were said to be in the market after the fall of the Malaysian ringgit against the U.S. dollar, dealers said on Monday.
"We heard Michelin picked up some RSS3 and that Bridgestone and Firestone may likely buy, especially after the ringgit fell against the dollar," a dealer said.
Other consumers were said to be looking for forward supplies of rubber. Goodyear was said to be asking for price quotes in the market, but has not been able to conclude a deal yet, traders said.
"We're seeing some modest shortcovering by consumers who feel prices are now at levels that are pretty attractive for them," a trader said.

The rubber trade kept a wary eye on the possibility that the International Natural Rubber Organisation (INRO) may intervene in the market after prices fell last week below the 'may-buy' level of 183.00 Malaysian/Singapore cents a kg.
"It's something we are looking out for," a dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, September RSS3 was seen at 94.25 U.S. cents a kg from 93.50 cents. October TSR20 was seen at 101 U.S. cents a kg from 100.50 cents. - Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
